Dallas cardiology

Cardiology Marketing Agency for Dallas Practices and Referral Teams

Many Dallas cardiology groups already have people working on referrals: a physician liaison visiting primary care offices, a referral coordinator, sometimes a hospital marketing partner. What they often lack is a website and local presence that backs that work up, and reporting that shows which inquiries came directly from patients and which came through referral activity. We fill that gap and work alongside the team you already have.

We serve Dallas from Houston, remotely. We have no Dallas office.

Availability: Dallas cardiology is open, subject to a ZIP check. Red Oak is reserved. Reserved areas can request a complimentary audit.
Request a Dallas cardiology consultation

Dallas cardiology challenges

Referral work happens offline, and the website does not support it

Dallas cardiology is served by large health systems, multi-specialty groups and independent practices. Independent groups depend heavily on referring physicians, yet their websites rarely help a referral coordinator act quickly. At the same time, patients increasingly search directly, and those searches land on pages that were not written for them.

No referral resources online

Liaisons hand out fax numbers on paper. The website has no referral page, so offices cannot self-serve or forward the link.

Profiles written for peers only

Bios list fellowships but not which patients each cardiologist sees or where, so direct patients cannot choose.

Everything counted as one number

Reports combine every call and form, so the practice cannot tell whether liaison work or search is producing inquiries.

Vendor bottlenecks

A website vendor controls changes, so simple fixes wait weeks without a clear specification.

Services

Cardiology marketing services for Dallas groups

We select deliverables after review. Outcomes such as rankings or referral volume are not guaranteed.

Referral hub and liaison support

A referral page your liaison can share, with fax or portal steps, required records, contacts and a printable summary.

Patient-facing physician profiles

Profiles that explain focus areas and offices in plain language, approved by each cardiologist.

Local SEO per office

Accurate office pages and Google profiles across Dallas-area offices.

Google Ads for cardiologists in Dallas

Campaigns for services or offices you choose, with landing pages and ad-policy review.

Vendor-ready specifications

Clear tickets and page drafts your website vendor can implement, or direct changes where allowed.

Split reporting

Direct inquiries and referral-related actions reported separately, by office and campaign.

Cardiology website design for Dallas practices is scoped separately when needed. See our cardiology marketing overview.

Process and evidence

How we work with a Dallas cardiology team

We agree who owns what on day one: your liaison, your vendor, your administrator and us.

  1. Assess

    Website, listings, ads, tracking and current referral process, including what your liaison hands out.

  2. Prioritize

    Usually the referral hub and office data first, because they help both patients and referrers immediately.

  3. Fix foundations

    Repairs, office pages, profile corrections and tracking labels for direct versus referral actions.

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Patient-facing profiles, service pages and optional Google Ads.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly split report shared with your liaison and administrator.

Illustrative reporting excerpt

How a split report is laid out

Who does what: we build and report. Your team processes referrals, schedules and approves clinical content.

Coverage and engagement

Serving Dallas cardiology practices

Remote service from Houston. Territory eligibility is checked by ZIP code; Red Oak, a separate city south of Dallas, is reserved.

Open, subject to ZIP check

Dallas and nearby cities

We check each office address. Red Oak is reserved for cardiology.

Arrangement

How we work

Video meetings, shared task list, monthly report and call. Works alongside liaisons and vendors.

Ownership

Your accounts

Website, listings and ad accounts remain the practice’s property.

Local search notes (reviewed 6 November 2026)

Agency searches such as ‘cardiology marketing agency Dallas’ returned national specialty agencies and Dallas round-ups of general healthcare or lead-generation firms. Public job listings show Dallas-area cardiology groups hiring physician liaisons for field referral marketing, which is why we design our work to support an existing referral team. Qualitative observations only.

Pricing

Scope-based proposal after review, with fees, ad spend and one-time work separated; 7 days’ notice. See the cost guide, our medical SEO in Dallas page and the Texas hub.

Questions and consultation

Dallas cardiology marketing questions

For administrators, liaisons and physician leaders.

Can you coordinate with our website vendor and referral team?

Yes. We agree responsibilities at the start: your liaison owns relationships with referring offices, your vendor owns the platform if contracted to, and we own search, content structure, campaigns and reporting. We provide vendor-ready specifications and share reports with your referral team so everyone works from the same data.

How will reporting distinguish direct inquiries from referral-related activity?

We label actions by where they start: referral-hub forms, tagged links your liaison shares and referral-page downloads are referral-related; calls and forms from patient-facing pages are direct. It is not perfect, since some referred patients search for you directly, so we explain the limits and, where your team can share intake source data, we add it.

What does a cardiology marketing agency in Dallas do?

Builds and maintains the online side of how patients and referrers reach you: website, listings, profiles, referral resources, optional ads and reporting.

Do you replace our physician liaison?

No. Field relationships need a person. We make the liaison’s work easier to act on and to measure.

How much does it cost?

Scope-based after review, with management fee, ad spend and one-time work listed separately.

Is our Dallas ZIP code available?

Send office addresses. Red Oak is reserved for cardiology; other ZIP codes are checked individually.

Can you show AI-search readiness without promising mentions?

Yes. We check how clearly your physicians, services and offices are described and structured, and report what we changed. We do not promise that any AI tool will recommend you.
